subject: INC-1076: which host started with a different configuration
body:
Hello -- Tomas Vik, data. We think one billing host loaded a different
configuration at startup. Tell me which host it is and which key is set
differently from the others.

The logs of every host for the incident window are in logs/, one file per host.
The startup banner prints the configuration one key per line.

Regards, Tomas Vik -- data
